items.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Hit With DDR5 Patent Cases At ITC And Federal Court
items.summary: Netlist has filed new patent complaints against Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI) at the U.S. International Trade Commission and in U.S. District Court regarding DDR5 memory module technology. The ITC case seeks an investigation into alleged infringement and potential exclusion of certain Super Micro DDR5 products from the U.S. market.
